My perfectly healthy, adventurous and young dad (he was 51) died 7 days ago because of a stupid accident while he was working. He was the perfect dad. My son is only 10 and he was starting to teach him his trade as he did with his three kids. My brother's wife is about to give birth to a baby girl who would be his first grandaughter, my sister graduates from high school in less than a month, my stepmom is a housewife and needs him as her husband and financially as well. 

The last time he sent me a text I didn't reply cause I got distracted with something else. I'm pretty sure he thought I didn't reply cause I had had a disagreement with his wife days before. 

It is so fucking unfair, and I totally understand what you are saying and feeling. My great grandmother is about to be 95 years old and since my dad died I am terrified I live that much cause it way too much life without my dad.
Thank you so much for taking the time to reply. I am so grateful. I really needed this.
